title: Independent Sets and Continued Fractions
summary: Linek's 1989 problem asks whether the numbers of independent sets of trees avoid infinitely many positive integers. We show that the set of natural numbers realized as the number of independent sets of a tree has a lower growth exponent of $0.1966$. We further prove that the set of positive integers representable by connected planar graphs has asymptotic density one.
